targets.authors: Kühnisch, J.; Thiering, E.; Heitmüller, D.; Tiesler, C.M.T.; Grallert, H.; Heinrich-Weltzien, R.; Hickel, R.; Heinrich, J.; The GINI-10 plus study group; The LISA-10 plus study group
targets.title: Genome-wide association study (GWAS) for molar–incisor hypomineralization (MIH)
targets.evidence_quote: Our analyses have replicated some association studies from the GWAS by Kühnisch et al. performed in an independent cohort of children.
targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, our replication study in Polish children did not confirm highly significant associations of molar incisor hypomineralization with rs2889956, rs4811117, or rs13058467, which were previously suggested to be possibly linked to MIH using a significance threshold p-value of <1 × 10−6 in a GWAS that assessed German children.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit final nonconfirmation verdict for the three tested loci. Low power is discussed as a limitation but does not replace the substantive nonconfirmation verdict; the combined-dataset exploratory analysis is not this new-sample replication.

reasoning: Title and author list match. New independent Polish sample tests three loci from one German GWAS paper.
